paper_title: MALADE Orchestration of LLM-powered Agents with Retrieval Augmented   Generation for Pharmacovigilance
caption: Derivation of ADE Scores from Event Probability. The x-axis represents the LLM's output probability estimate, and the color indicates the mapping for the corresponding set of labels.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the derivation of ADE (Adverse Drug Event) scores based on the estimated probability of effect as output by an LLM, with two distinct mappings corresponding to different label sets: “Decreased Risk” (green line) and “No Effect OR Increased Risk” (orange line). The x-axis, labeled “Estimated Probability of Effect,” spans from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled “ADE Score,” also ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 linearly, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The green line, representing “Decreased Risk,” starts at an ADE score of 0.5 when the estimated probability is 0.0 and decreases linearly to an ADE score of 0.0 at a probability of 1.0. In contrast, the orange line, representing “No Effect OR Increased Risk,” begins at 0.5 when the probability is 0.0 and increases linearly to an ADE score of 1.0 at a probability of 1.0. Both lines are solid and intersect at the point (0.0, 0.5), diverging symmetrically as probability increases, with no markers used on either line.
